message: Hi, my kid Nia is 8 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do! We have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes for 8-year-olds. It's a great program with age-appropriate instruction in a really safe and welcoming environment. Is Nia interested in trying a free trial class?
Yes, that sounds great! When can she try the free trial class?
Awesome! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial details to?
You can send the details to tester.kestrel@gmail.com.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Now I just need Nia's full name for the trial class.
Her full name is Nia Kestrel.
Perfect! And what's Nia's date of birth? This helps us make sure she's in the right age group.

Great! Nia is 8 so she's perfect for our Kids BJJ program. Here are some available times for her free trial:

Wednesday 7/8 at 4:30 PM
Friday 7/10 at 4:30 PM
Saturday 7/11 at 10:00 AM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Saturday 7/11 at 10:00 AM.

Perfect! Nia is all set for Saturday 7/11 at 10:00 AM. You'll get a confirmation email at tester.kestrel@gmail.com with all the details. Just have her wear comfortable workout clothes. See you both then!
